summary: Four cold reads on the spec. Round 1 (9 findings) corrected attended-only job editing per 0106, a stale truncation premise, the compare-and-swap token, and falsifiable acceptance. Round 2 (10 findings) surfaced the contradiction between the proposed capability direction and accepted 0120 and 0130, which was escalated to the owner and ratified: the argv template stays the enforcement boundary and discovery is the defect, recorded as accepted decision 0158. This round's 7 findings are all resolved in the amended spec and in an amendment to 0153.
gaps: The active decision corpus is contradictory: 0153 still excludes the autonomous classifier while 0157 enables it, and the spec only noted it.
definition_revision is not reusable yet: 0108 requires a migration the jobs schema does not have, so document CAS cannot assume it.
Capability discovery is specified as an outcome, not a mechanism; the initial catalog omits the capability's stable id and its invocation shape.
AC2 cannot falsify the claimed behaviour, and AC5 can pass vacuously when no successful invocation occurs.
document_ref authority is undefined at the load-bearing boundary and risks copying the legacy conversation-derived check.
The scheduled-mutation protection is incomplete: only forged provenance was tested, not absence of the edit tools from scheduled surfaces.
The secret rule is a validity oracle: a distinct redacted-overlap refusal differs from not-found, and redaction can collapse a multiline secret and break line coordinates.
contradictions: The proposed relaxation of the reviewed argv template contradicted accepted 0120, which makes argv validation the credential and account boundary, and accepted 0130, which forbids any classifier-derived or cached allow reaching the capability wrapper.
resolutions: Amended docs/decisions/0153-learned-decisions-project-into-job-grants.md with a 2026-09-10 amendment retiring the classifier-exclusion clauses and keeping the projection; spec now cites 0043 and 0157.

Spec now declares completing decision 0108 as owned scope, citing the missing column at schema/jobs.ts:20, and adds acceptance criterion 6 plus a race test against a concurrent whole-document update in criterion 11.

Spec now names the model-visible catalog at agent-prompt-capability-guidance.ts:241 as the seam, requires the stable capability id and invocation shape in the initial materialization, corrects the 97ded3746 characterisation to the runtime capability context, and removes only the superseded per-capability block while keeping the generic dispatcher contract.

Acceptance criterion 1 asserts the exact rendered descriptor over the real materialization path; criterion 2 requires a named deterministic replay with no live model call; criterion 5 requires at least one successful capability invocation per run.

Spec now binds document_ref to the canonical owner of decision 0114 and the acting person of decision 0118, fails closed when either is unresolvable, and explicitly does not reuse job-management-access.ts:9; acceptance criterion 15 proves it.

Spec now requires both halves of decision 0106: the edit tools are absent from scheduled tool surfaces while document_view remains a read, and acceptance criterion 14 tests both absence and forged-provenance rejection.

Spec now requires the protected-span refusal to be byte-identical to the not-found response with rate-limited repeats, coordinate-preserving redaction, and ingress-time redaction before any permission or audit persistence; acceptance criteria 12 and 13 prove them.

Escalated to the owner and ratified: the argv template remains the enforcement boundary, 0120 and 0130 stand unamended, discovery is the defect. Recorded as decision 0158 (accepted, confirmed_by Ravi), which also records relaxation as future direction gated on a replacement boundary that must supersede 0120 and 0130 explicitly.
open_items: Non-blocking: making reviewed argv templates easier to extend is follow-up work and does not require touching the enforcement gate (0158 consequences).
Non-blocking: binding a second document store to the same contract is deferred; version one binds the scheduled-job prompt only.
